metaDescription: Whippet vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Whippet boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Plan Whippet social milestones around the schedule rows, not the other way around, because the 16-week finish is the usual green light clinics cite for broader Whippet exposure.
Weight range 25-40 lb (11-18 kg) and grooming needs (Short coat; cold weather coats help.) belong in the same Whippet household ops list as vaccine dates when busy weeks collide.
If your Whippet is also monitored for dental disease, ask whether bloodwork or orthopedic checks can share a visit with a booster to cut missed Whippet appointments.
After the Whippet puppy/kitten series, keep adult DA2PP / DHPP and rabies renewals on 7/3/1-day reminders so year-two surprises disappear.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: If your Whippet misses the dose scheduled near week 12, call the clinic the same day with product names — do not restart the Whippet series from memory.
The danger for a delayed Whippet is the gap, not the embarrassment, because parvovirus pressure stays real for an under-vaccinated puppy even in clean-looking neighborhoods.
While waiting for the make-up DA2PP / DHPP visit, skip high-traffic dog parks / unknown-cat intros and keep the Whippet away from unvaccinated animals.
After catch-up, rewrite reminders for the next Whippet due date (7, 3, and 1 day prior) so the same miss does not recur.

faqs.question: When does the Whippet core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Whippet misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Whippet health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Whippet adult health guide for breed predispositions such as heart screening needs, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
